description: Players whose consensus average draft position disagrees most with their actual production ranking. A player taken EARLIER than his production is being drafted on expectation (a rookie, a new situation, a bounce-back); one taken LATER is being drafted on doubt. Use this for draft-prep questions about who the room may be mispricing. This is a disagreement, NOT a recommendation: production is last season's, while ADP already prices in injuries, trades and rookies with no NFL snaps.

direction.description: earlier_than_production: the room drafts him sooner than his production ranks him. later_than_production: the room waits longer. Omit for both.

position.description: Restrict to one position. Omit for all four.

scoring_format.description: Scoring format. ppr awards 1 point per reception, half_ppr 0.5, standard 0. Defaults to half_ppr, the most common league setting.

name: get_adp_market_gaps

adp_season.description: The season the draft board is for.

drafts_sampled.description: How many real drafts the consensus averages over.

adp.description: Overall pick, averaged. Lower is earlier.

adp_rank.description: Rank at the position by draft position.

gap.description: adp_rank minus production_rank. Positive means taken later than production.

production_rank.description: Our rank at the position by points per game. 1 is best.

refreshed_at.description: When this dataset was last refreshed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

stats_season.description: The completed NFL season every figure in this result describes.

url.description: The draftcall.io page these figures came from. This is the citation to use.

title: Where the draft room disagrees with production
